title: MaxBLD report page tree (the v21 page contract)
$comment: MF-57 (decision D-A (a), held for the operator): THE one home of the v21 report PAGE tree, beside the node contract report-tree.schema.json, which is unchanged; an ad section reuses its `$defs/slot` (R-17, R-34) by $ref. A page tree = the sections of scripts/surfaces/_schema/report-page.json in screen order; a part is ONE shown text with ONE binding: `value` (a declared field's server-formatted text, sent under `key`; R17, FE-05), `content` (a key of report-presentation.json `page`) or `pending` (Q-G4 a: the ruled text, no value). `brief` names the element of fields/REPORT-LAYOUT-BRIEF-v4.md. Checks the schema cannot say (declared field, role vocabulary, Q-G4 a, the Sponsored disclosure) are in src/lib/surfaces/report/core.ts assertPage and src/tests/surfaces/report-page.logic.test.ts. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-19; operator D-1..D-8 "all as recommmended", D-5): the section kind lot_size_entered (the after-entry line C2) is added to the closed kind list; nothing else changes (the page flags decide which sections are built, never the tree shape).
